name: SURF Surface Campus, Lead, South Dakota

summary.plain: The above-ground part of the Sanford laboratory in Lead, South Dakota, with the shafts, offices and assembly buildings that serve the experiments a mile below.
summary.technical: Surface campus of SURF at the former Homestake mine, providing the Ross and Yates shaft heads, cleanrooms and support infrastructure for the underground campuses.
